name: Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (PC-PTSD-5)

citations.text: Prins A, Bovin MJ, Smolenski DJ, et al. The Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (PC-PTSD-5): development and evaluation within a veteran primary care sample. J Gen Intern Med. 2016;31(10):1206-1211.

validated_population: Adult veterans in primary care. Self-administered.
license_note: Developed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs National Center for PTSD; U.S. government work. Item wording is used verbatim. Verify current terms at ptsd.va.gov before deployment.

items.question: Sometimes things happen to people that are unusually or especially frightening, horrible, or traumatic. For example: a serious accident or fire; a physical or sexual assault or abuse; an earthquake or flood; a war; seeing someone be killed or seriously injured; having a loved one die through homicide or suicide. Have you ever experienced this kind of event?
items.help: Answer yes if any event like these happened to you or you saw it happen.

items.question: In the past month, have you had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
In the past month, have you tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
In the past month, have you been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
items.help: Jumpy or always watching for danger.

items.question: In the past month, have you felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
In the past month, have you felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?
items.help: Blame or guilt that will not go away.

scoring.threshold_text: Count of "yes" answers to the 5 symptom questions: 0–2 negative screen; 3–5 positive screen (cut-point 3, Prins 2016).

negative.label: Negative PTSD screen
negative.interpretation: Your answers do not meet the screening cut-point for probable PTSD.
negative.recommendation: No further PTSD evaluation needed now. Seek help if symptoms develop or worsen.

care.within: Self-care; primary care if symptoms develop
care.where_detail: Home care. Book a primary care visit if distress continues.
ed_redirect: Thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life: call or text 988 now
self_care: Veterans can call the Veterans Crisis Line: dial 988, then press 1.

positive.label: Positive PTSD screen
positive.interpretation: Your answers meet the screening cut-point for probable PTSD. A screen is not a diagnosis; a full evaluation is the next step.
positive.recommendation: Book an evaluation with a mental health clinician or primary care.

care.where_detail: Licensed mental health clinician, or primary care. Veterans: VA medical center or Vet Center.
ed_redirect: Thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life: call or text 988 now
